record.title: Reassess the B1 endpoint gate from separate evidence classes
record.intent: Decide whether offline implementation and corroborating evidence justify the one-query B1 candidate.
requirements: State whether the combined evidence is sufficient for a bounded identity query without calling it documented vendor port behavior or observed specimen behavior.
Preserve the original B1 proposal as a historical gate and record any superseding evidence assessment separately, including framing, firmware applicability and remaining authorization or lease gates.
Do not execute B1 or admit physical execution tasks. Commit and push the decision and stop for operator review.
acceptance: An explicit evidence-backed endpoint decision is recorded without contacting the specimen.
